name: Aubrey West
source:
Your former university roommate had a talent for talking through even your worst moods. Cheerful, persistent, and fond of terrible jokes, Aubrey kept trying to reach [url=/c148150]you[/url] when you gave him little encouragement. The friendship that followed was one of the few good things you brought back from those years.
